results.title: Eastman Chemical Company
results.snippet: The company is managed and reported in four operating segments: Additives & Functional Products, Advanced Materials, Chemical Intermediates and Fibers. The Additives & Functional Products segment makes chemicals for coatings and tires, serving the coatings, tires, consumables, animal nutrition, crop protection, and energy markets.

results.title: Eastman Chemical Company
results.snippet: The Advanced Materials segment produces and markets its polymers, films, and plastics with differentiated performance properties for value-added end uses in transportation, consumables, building and construction, durable goods, and health and wellness products.

results.title: Eastman Chemical Company
results.snippet: Key lines include specialty copolyesters and cellulose esters, interlayers (a specialty resin used in laminated safety glass), and performance films, which are aftermarket applied films that enhance automotive and architectural glass.

results.title: EASTMAN CHEMICAL CO - Form 10-K - FY2014
results.snippet: Adhesives resins and plasticizers are sold into the consumables, building and construction, health and wellness, industrial chemicals and processing, and durable goods markets.

results.title: EASTMAN CHEMICAL CO - Form 10-K - FY2015
results.snippet: Fibers products include Estron acetate tow and Estrobond triacetin plasticizers for use primarily in manufacture of cigarette filters.

results.title: EASTMAN CHEMICAL CO - Form 10-K - FY2019
results.snippet: The Chemical Intermediates segment leverages large-scale and vertical integration from the acetyl, olefins, and alkylamine streams to make products sold externally for markets such as industrial chemicals and processing, building and construction, health and wellness, and energy.
